raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cssutils
  version: "2.15.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e9739237f3915037dacba787c4b58f280e3ec5d9864953e185bf23d40ff7d021

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - csscapture=cssutils.scripts.csscapture:main
      - csscombine=cssutils.scripts.csscombine:main
      - cssparse=cssutils.scripts.cssparse:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools_scm >=3.4.1
    - setuptools >=77
    - coherent.licensed
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - more-itertools
    - encutils

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cssutils
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - csscapture --help
      - csscombine --help
      - cssparse --help

about:
  license: LGPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  summary: A CSS Cascading Style Sheets library for Python
  homepage: https://github.com/jaraco/cssutils

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - vamega
    - thewchan
